proposal.summary: Remote command injection in Zyxel USG FLEX (ZLD5.00 through ZLD5.21) via the /ztp/cgi-bin/handler 'setWanPortSt' API where attacker-controlled 'mtu' is injected into a shell command, allowing remote command execution (reverse shell shown).
proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm vulnerable endpoint and reproduce with safe non-interactive payload; collect exact affected firmware builds and request vendor patch or mitigation (e.g., input validation or command escaping) from Zyxel.

evidence_quotes.claim: exploit demonstrates command injection leading to a reverse shell
vulnerable endpoint path used by exploit
requests POST used to send JSON payload without authentication in the PoC
